_about: Golden for the car_page.js split (2026-10-01). tco: outputs of the ORIGINAL car_page.js TCO pure functions (HEAD 75671a38f, evaluated in node) on the 20 real cars' tco-intelligence-card attributes + synthetic edge cards. finance: monthly-payment text the ORIGINAL calculator showed in Chromium for each car (default tax 7%/fees $500 unless noted). browser: full Playwright recording per car (TCO/depreciation text + canvas hashes, finance, gallery next/prev/lightbox indexes, screenshot sha256 per tab at 1440/390) with fuel/tax lookups replayed from api_cache. browser_storage: finance persistence across reload, manual tax vs ZIP lookup, pageshow TCO re-init and the customize disclosure, recorded with the HEAD car_page.js.
